reuse.why: Introduces one selection helper that all five month-wide actions now use, though it parses goal_def itself rather than leaning on the template module's own reading of saved templates.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the category SQL; the per-action income/tracking check is left repeated in each action, as it was.

placement.why: getMonthWideCategories and hasSavedTemplates sit in budget/actions.ts beside the bulk actions they serve.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and a release note are touched; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: The hidden/template exclusion is now one function; the income rule is still decided in every action, so the selection is not fully owned by the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth via an id set, goes through getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated SQL is removed and shared, not reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden, hidden-group and saved-template rule and is called by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.
